title: Unkeywordify "Immune to tribal tag based hate"
notes: R940: Immune to tribal tag based hate on Blue-Eyes White Felinor is no longer a keyword but `static_flags.immune_to_tribal_hate` on both faces: its text prints it as an ability line, the board shows no keyword mark for it, and a Nerf, which draws among keyword rows, can no longer take it away. The keyword kind is retired, not deleted: the shipped catalogs that printed it still read, and the AI's feature layout keeps its length. The classifier's unforced games diverge wherever a Felinor's keywords or text show, so it names the four cards in `plays` and a rule every game meets.
